title: Schedule of Termination Notice and Apartment Change Terms, Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
Schedule to the **Entrance Fee Agreement** setting the notice lengths for ending the agreement after occupancy and the money terms of changing apartments on the campus. The terms are the same under the LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan, the LifeChoice 50%, 75% and 90% Refundable Plans, the LifeCare Declining Balance Plan and the LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan.

| Term | Each of the six plans |
|---|---|
| Resident's written notice of termination | 90 calendar days |
| Agreement ends on the date of death of the last resident without a notice period | Yes |
| Larkspur's written notice of termination for cause | 60 calendar days |
| Move to a larger apartment type: difference in entrance fee due | Yes |
| Move to a smaller apartment type: difference in entrance fee refunded | No |
| Administrative fee for a resident-requested apartment change | 1500.00 USD |

## Reading the schedule

- Termination by the resident runs on a 90 calendar day notice; termination by Larkspur for cause runs on a 60 calendar day notice.
- An upsize brings a payment; a downsize brings no refund. The apartment change fee of 1500.00 applies in both directions.
